commit_message:
[Codegen] Add bufferization support for CastToRaggedShapeOp and LinearizeRaggedDimsOp (#24193)

This is PR 4/N of landing block sparse changes that are captured in this
branch :


https://github.com/MaheshRavishankar/iree/tree/users/MaheshRavishankar/blockSparseCommits

Adds `BufferizableOpInterfac`e external models for two tensor-ext ops
that describe ragged shapes:
- `iree_tensor_ext.cast_to_ragged_shape` — reinterprets a source buffer
as a rank-(n+1) ragged buffer by
attaching a RaggedShapeAttr as the memref layout.
-`iree_tensor_ext.linearize_ragged_dims` — the inverse view: collapses
the ragged dimensions of a source
buffer back into a single dense dimension and drops the ragged layout.
  
Both ops are pure views, so the interface implementations:
- Report the operands as reads and never as writes (including
`resultBufferizesToMemoryWrite = false`).
- Set `mustBufferizeInPlace = true` and mark the result as
`BufferRelation::Equivalent` to source, so
bufferization does not introduce a copy.
- For `cast_to_ragged_shape`, the result memref's layout is the ragged
encoding promoted from the tensor
encoding; operand buffers use the identity layout.
- For `linearize_ragged_dims`, both operand and result memrefs use the
identity layout; the result simply
drops the ragged encoding.
`bufferize` replaces the tensor-typed op with an identical memref-typed
version of itself — no data is
moved.

commit_message:
[TensorExt] Add ResolveSparseInterfaceOps pass and rewrite patterns

After bufferization, a memref produced by `iree_tensor_ext.cast_to_ragged_shape`
carries a ragged layout that the backends cannot lower directly. This adds
patterns that rewrite reads from such memrefs into reads from the underlying
source memref, using `SparseOpInterface::resolveRange` to translate the ragged
(row, column) indices into linearized source indices.

Patterns (`populateSparseInterfaceRewritePatterns`):
- `vector.transfer_read`, `vector.load`, `vector.maskedload` and `memref.load`
  from a ragged-shaped memref are rewritten to read from the source. For
  `vector.transfer_read` the permutation map and `in_bounds` are remapped to
  the collapsed source dimensions; reads whose vector dims touch the sparse
  dims are left alone.

Patterns (`populateResolveDimOfCastToRaggedShapePatterns`):
- `tensor.dim`/`memref.dim` of the ragged-row dimension of a
  `cast_to_ragged_shape` result folds to `numRaggedRows`. The ragged column
  dimension varies per row and is not resolved.

The `iree-tensor-ext-resolve-sparse-interface-ops` pass applies the first set
with the greedy driver. Region simplification is disabled in its config: the
pass only rewrites memory accesses and must not merge blocks or otherwise
restructure control flow (the default `Aggressive` level does so even when no
pattern applies, which broke later lowering on CPU).

The patterns are tested through the existing
`iree-tensor-ext-test-sparse-op-interface-methods` pass via a new
`test-resolve-range-rewriters` option. The pass is not added to any pipeline
yet; that happens in a follow-up.

After bufferization, a memref produced by `iree_tensor_ext.cast_to_ragged_shape`
carries a ragged layout that the backends cannot lower directly. This adds
patterns that rewrite reads from such memrefs into reads from the underlying
source memref, using `SparseOpInterface::resolveRange` to translate the ragged
(row, column) indices into linearized source indices.

Patterns (`populateSparseInterfaceRewritePatterns`):
- `vector.transfer_read`, `vector.load`, `vector.maskedload` and `memref.load`
  from a ragged-shaped memref are rewritten to read from the source. For
  `vector.transfer_read` the permutation map and `in_bounds` are remapped to
  the collapsed source dimensions; reads whose vector dims touch the sparse
  dims are left alone.

- `tensor.dim`/`memref.dim` of the ragged-row dimension of a
  `cast_to_ragged_shape` result folds to `numRaggedRows`. The ragged column
  dimension varies per row and is not resolved.

commit_message:
[TensorExt] Add ResolveSparseInterfaceOps pass and rewrite patterns

After bufferization, a memref produced by `iree_tensor_ext.cast_to_ragged_shape`
carries a ragged layout that the backends cannot lower directly. This adds
patterns that rewrite reads from such memrefs into reads from the underlying
source memref, using `SparseOpInterface::resolveRange` to translate the ragged
(row, column) indices into linearized source indices.

Patterns (`populateSparseInterfaceRewritePatterns`):
- `vector.transfer_read`, `vector.load`, `vector.maskedload` and `memref.load`
  from a ragged-shaped memref are rewritten to read from the source. For
  `vector.transfer_read` the permutation map and `in_bounds` are remapped to
  the collapsed source dimensions; reads whose vector dims touch the sparse
  dims are left alone.

Patterns (`populateResolveDimOfCastToRaggedShapePatterns`):
- `tensor.dim`/`memref.dim` of the ragged-row dimension of a
  `cast_to_ragged_shape` result folds to `numRaggedRows`. The ragged column
  dimension varies per row and is not resolved.

The `iree-tensor-ext-resolve-sparse-interface-ops` pass applies the first set
with the greedy driver. Region simplification is disabled in its config: the
pass only rewrites memory accesses and must not merge blocks or otherwise
restructure control flow (the default `Aggressive` level does so even when no
pattern applies, which broke later lowering on CPU).

The patterns are tested through the existing
`iree-tensor-ext-test-sparse-op-interface-methods` pass via a new
`test-resolve-range-rewriters` option. The pass is not added to any pipeline
yet; that happens in a follow-up.

commit_message:
[Codegen] Add bufferization support for CastToRaggedShapeOp and LinearizeRaggedDimsOp (#24193)

This is PR 4/N of landing block sparse changes that are captured in this
branch :


https://github.com/MaheshRavishankar/iree/tree/users/MaheshRavishankar/blockSparseCommits

Adds `BufferizableOpInterfac`e external models for two tensor-ext ops
that describe ragged shapes:
- `iree_tensor_ext.cast_to_ragged_shape` — reinterprets a source buffer
as a rank-(n+1) ragged buffer by
attaching a RaggedShapeAttr as the memref layout.
-`iree_tensor_ext.linearize_ragged_dims` — the inverse view: collapses
the ragged dimensions of a source
buffer back into a single dense dimension and drops the ragged layout.
  
Both ops are pure views, so the interface implementations:
- Report the operands as reads and never as writes (including
`resultBufferizesToMemoryWrite = false`).
- Set `mustBufferizeInPlace = true` and mark the result as
`BufferRelation::Equivalent` to source, so
bufferization does not introduce a copy.
- For `cast_to_ragged_shape`, the result memref's layout is the ragged
encoding promoted from the tensor
encoding; operand buffers use the identity layout.
- For `linearize_ragged_dims`, both operand and result memrefs use the
identity layout; the result simply
drops the ragged encoding.
`bufferize` replaces the tensor-typed op with an identical memref-typed
version of itself — no data is
moved.
